text: Everybody wants to take the red pill, but no one talks about what happens afterwards. Agent Smith vibrates within hell, and its only job is to block you from ever escaping. We then go into the woman in the red dress, the distractions that we have in life. Gluttony, lust, pride, this in-between that keeps you sinning, that keeps you distracted from your purpose. When you've let go of distractions and you truly find who you are, you are the one. Neo vibrates at 200 courage, which is the courage to be yourself, which is the courage to take the path completely away from your subconscious programming and who you truly are. And Neo becomes best friends with Morpheus. Morpheus is your intuition, constantly whispering as to what you should do. And the more that Neo listens and trusts 310 Morpheus, that's when he's able to ascend towards Trinity. This is not romantic energy between a man and a woman. This is when you unconditionally love every single thing that has ever happened to you, you in the past so that you could use it in order to get to 1,000. Pure enlightenment is non-attachment. This is all a simulation. Nothing matters. The only thing that matters is you being completely yourself, unattached from anything outside of you.
